intent: Implement the scoped Real Estate route-card Brickell loop from the approved experience brief. Preserve every other route-card composition and behavior.

visual_evidence.scope_reason: Only the closed Real Estate route card is changing.
visual_evidence.correction_excerpt: Imágenes grandes, protagonistas y legibles, con recorte intencional.
visual_evidence.comparison: Preserve the approved Content Creator card and the later route cards unchanged.

brief.visitor: A South Florida property professional deciding whether Esteban can make their listings look worth viewing.
brief.promise: A real-estate route that immediately feels like elevated South Florida property video work.
brief.primary_action: Open the Real Estate route to see relevant plans and project options.
brief.friction: The existing low-quality still makes the real-estate route feel weaker than the owner-approved neighboring routes.

kpi.denominator: homepage visitors who reach the route chooser
kpi.baseline: UNKNOWN: no comparable homepage route-selection denominator exists; establish one before outcome grading.
kpi.evidence: No comparable route-selection denominator was inspected in this task.
kpi.readout: T+7 and T+14 after production deployment
kpi.decision_rule: Retain if visual QA is clean; assess qualified-inquiry evidence only against a comparable future denominator.

concept.idea: A quiet looping Brickell aerial gives Real Estate its own credible property scene while leaving the written decision unobstructed.
concept.brand_reason: Esteban's homepage opens with cinematic camera language; a real South Florida aerial continues that mood better than an undersized still.
concept.interaction: The card keeps its existing native disclosure control; video is decorative and never required to read or act.
concept.visible_response: The aerial has restrained continuous motion; opening the card retains the current visible details behavior.
concept.direct_path: The existing plus control remains the obvious route-opening action.
concept.alternatives: Do not add badges, fake listing telemetry, or another overlay UI.

story.opening: A clear Brickell property aerial establishes place.
story.action: The visitor reads the Real Estate offer and opens the card.
story.consequence: The existing plans and related options become visible in the same route.
story.next_step: The visitor chooses the appropriate existing quote path.

content.visible: Existing Real Estate eyebrow, title, explanation, and open control.
content.optional_html: Existing native details content and plan disclosures.

references.borrow: Caro's verified 3.2-second vertical Brickell loop, with a poster fallback and reduced-motion respect.
references.avoid: Do not copy Caro's visual brand, claims, or navigation; do not imply Esteban filmed a named building.

components.reuse: Existing HomeProjectPath route-card, native details interaction, and application navigation behavior.
components.local_reason: The media treatment is brand- and route-specific; it should not alter shared navigation or the other route cards.

verification.rendered_states: Inspect closed and open card at 375x600, 390x844, and desktop; check neighboring cards remain unchanged.
verification.motion: Verify autoplay loop in normal motion and static poster under reduced motion.
verification.accessibility_performance: Keep the video muted, playsInline, decorative, and out of the accessibility tree; preserve the 44px open control.
verification.raw_html: Verify all existing title and choice text remains in initial HTML.
verification.conversion_boundary: Do not submit a lead; verify the existing quote action remains reachable.

learning.baseline_source: UNKNOWN; establish a comparable homepage chooser denominator before outcome grading
learning.baseline_value: UNKNOWN: no comparable homepage route-selection denominator exists; establish one before outcome grading.
learning.hypothesis: A credible, readable property scene makes the real-estate route easier to trust and choose.
learning.decision_rule: Keep if the route passes visual and behavior review; do not claim business impact until a comparable measurement is available.
learning.registration_condition: Register the exact event and comparable denominator before interpreting outcome data.
